reason: The indexed monoclinic cell and Z=2 content are strongly supported, and the submitted P21 models are parseable and have plausible minimum contacts, so the average framework is credible. Exact recovery is not sufficiently established: the comparable whole-pattern report supplies no candidate scores; the trace's best reported whole-profile Rwp is still 0.1683 versus a Le Bail floor of 0.1113; and the coordinates written to the submitted CIFs are not the coordinates from that whole-profile refinement. More importantly, all six Sb/Te assignments were explicitly refined with nearly indistinguishable isolated-reflection objectives (0.02970-0.03046), but only three were submitted, leaving at least one distinct ordering class uncovered. Thus the diffraction evidence does not resolve the element ordering, coordinates, and symmetry realization well enough to stop, and another attempt should compare the surviving ordered models on a common whole-pattern basis and broaden the symmetry/model test.
